problem_type: Session hooks drift when the primary checkout stays stale
symptom: Claude sessions keep loading old main-checkout hooks and obsolete validation reminders.
direct_cause: The primary main checkout was left behind origin/main with local generated edits. The initial follow hook also treated harmless untracked files as dirty, skipping every future update.
class_root: SessionStart has no shared boundary that follows a clean primary main checkout or reports why it cannot.
affected_population: Primary checkout sessions after upstream updates
Sessions with tracked or untracked local work, topic branches, divergent history or unavailable remotes
internal_only_reason: This is an internal checkout ownership policy explicitly specified in the task brief; Git CLI already supplies ff-only and locking.
invariants: Only the primary checkout root on main with no tracked edits may fast-forward; Git rejects untracked path collisions.
Linked worktrees and user edits never change.
Offline, contention and divergence warn and return success.

door_reduction.why_not: One new shared CLI boundary owns advancement; SessionStart invokes it instead of maintaining a second implementation.

generality_proof: Root identity, branch and tracked-only porcelain status guard every invocation before fetch and are rechecked before ff-only merge; Git owns untracked collision detection, divergence and concurrent locks; its refusal diagnostics stay visible.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own checkout eligibility, fetch timeout, ff-only mutation and nonblocking warnings.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Existing registered hook invokes the shared CLI before reading a handoff card.
Current code already stores machine-level radar results outside the checkout; no new tracked writes.

recurrence.reason: Every upstream update or later local edit can recreate stale hooks without a SessionStart boundary.
same_class_scan: Read model-radar.ts RESULT_DIR and writeSnapshot; runSession door map and hook writer review.

prevention.invariant: Only a primary main checkout without tracked edits advances by Git ff-only; nonconflicting untracked files survive and blocking paths appear in the refusal warning.
prevention.failure_mode: Keep checkout unchanged and emit one visible warning; session exits 0.
prevention.strategy: SessionStart invokes Git eligibility and advancement at one boundary, independent of human recall.

legacy_paths.rationale: There was no automatic update implementation; existing handoff reading remains the same owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Only installed Node builtins and Git CLI are used; no package API or dependency upgrade.

migration: Manual main checkout advancement preserves the original binary patch and untracked files; no user project or model-data migration.
residual_risks: Real daily-radar and handoff-write hooks are read-only reviewed because the task excludes keys and real state writes.
Untracked files are preserved; actual upstream path collisions prevent fast-forward and are named in the Git refusal warning.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The SessionStart CLI enforces primary checkout identity and Git advancement in one tested boundary.
